page.overview:
What is Ennard?

is the twisted Amalgamation of the Funtime animatronics. He first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location as the final antagonist.

Ennard is made out of the five main animatronics in Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental (Circus Baby, Ballora, Funtime Freddy, Bon-Bon, and Funtime Foxy), as well as the clown mask from the Primary Control Module (evident from its disappearance in Night 5). Ennard has a bulky yet noticeably humanoid build. He also has long, null teeth that are similar to Ballora's endoskeleton. His head shape, beside the mask, is taken from Ballora. Wires hang from his mouth, similar to the appearance of drool.

Ennard has a few eyes attached to his body, each one belonging to one of the five core animatronics, except for Funtime Freddy, who has two eyes. In Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2, Ennard's two "primary" eyes are now blue while the rest of his eyes are now yellow.
